title: [Articles] Development and external validation of an interpretable machine learning score for early sepsis identification in the emergency department: a multicentre retrospective cohort study
zh_title: 急诊早期脓毒症识别的可解释机器学习评分：多中心外部验证
summary: eClinicalMedicine 开发并外部验证分诊时可计算的整数评分，跨医疗系统仍保持判别力，可识别急诊脓毒症风险。
key_points: 多中心回顾队列，评分可在分诊时计算
外部验证无需本地重新估计即保持判别力

abstract: An integer score computed at triage identified ED patients at risk of sepsis with discrimination that transferred across health systems without local re-estimation, supporting its use for risk stratification at triage. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether acting on it shortens time to treatment and improves outcomes.
zh_abstract: 一种在分诊时计算的整数评分可识别有脓毒症风险的急诊科患者，其区分能力在不同卫生系统间迁移而无需本地重新估计，支持将其用于分诊时的风险分层。需要进行前瞻性评估，以确定据此采取行动是否能缩短治疗时间并改善结局。

title: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions
zh_title: 胰腺囊性病变患者胰腺癌风险的 AI 预测模型
summary: npj Digital Medicine 用放射报告与临床数据构建 AI 模型预测胰腺囊性病变患者未来胰腺癌风险，多中心回顾队列 8707 例。
key_points: 13 年回顾队列，23,398 份腹部 CT/MRI 报告
430 例（1.8%）后续发生胰腺癌
XGBoost 最优，AUC 0.960/0.945/0.944
reason: 大样本多中心回顾研究，但摘要未显示独立外部验证，按回顾性内部验证档上限计
abstract: Pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are prevalent and potential precursors of pancreatic cancer. Cancer risk assessment is a crucial step in PCL management, but the complexity and limited accuracy of existing approaches contribute to suboptimal patient care. We developed and validated an artificial intelligence (AI) model that uses radiology reports and clinical data to predict the future risk of pancreatic cancer in patients with PCLs. The model was developed and tested in a 13-year retrospective cohort comprising 23,398 abdominal CT/MRI examination reports from 8707 patients with PCLs across a multisite healthcare system. Of these, 430 (1.8%) corresponded to patients who later developed pancreatic cancer, defined as adenocarcinoma, invasive mucinous neoplasm, or high-grade dysplasia. Among the models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest performance, with AUCs of 0.960, 0.945, and 0.944 for predicting pancreatic cancer incidence at 1, 3, and 5 years after imaging, respectively. The model outperformed guideline-based risk stratification, with AUC improvements of 0.161 to 0.235 (P < 0.001). For examinations conducted within a year before cancer diagnosis, radiologists identified potential cancer in 51.5% of cases, while the AI model flagged 82.3%. These findings support the potential of AI to complement existing approaches for individualized pancreatic cancer risk stratification in patients with PCLs.
zh_abstract: 胰腺囊性病变（PCLs）很常见，并且是胰腺癌的潜在前驱病变。癌症风险评估是 PCL 管理中的关键步骤，但现有方法的复杂性和有限准确性导致患者照护欠佳。我们开发并验证了一种人工智能（AI）模型，该模型使用放射学报告和临床数据来预测 PCL 患者未来发生胰腺癌的风险。该模型在一个为期13年的回顾性队列中开发并测试，该队列包含来自多站点医疗系统8707例 PCL 患者的23,398份腹部 CT/MRI 检查报告。其中，430份（1.8%）对应后来发生胰腺癌的患者，胰腺癌定义为腺癌、浸润性黏液性肿瘤或高级别异型增生。在评估的模型中，XGBoost 取得了最高性能，在预测影像检查后1年、3年和5年胰腺癌发病风险方面的 AUC 分别为0.960、0.945和0.944。该模型优于基于指南的风险分层，AUC 提升为0.161至0.235（P < 0.001）。对于癌症诊断前一年内进行的检查，放射科医生在51.5%的病例中识别出潜在癌症，而 AI 模型提示了82.3%。这些发现支持 AI 在 PCL 患者个体化胰腺癌风险分层中补充现有方法的潜力。

title: VoxelSlicer: Adaptive Voxel-wise Slicer for Deformable Image Registration.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: VoxelSlicer：面向可变形图像配准的自适应体素切片模块
summary: IEEE TMI 提出 VoxelSlicer 神经模块，通过可学习自适应滤波实现体素级滤波，改善形变配准中的局部不连续与消息传递效率。
key_points: 针对腹部跨受试者与心脏等高度形变场景
以双边网格为灵感，做可学习自适应滤波
指出现有各向同性成对正则导致边界过平滑
reason: 同行评审方法创新，摘要未提外部验证、临床结局或开源，属值得一看档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Recent progress in neural networks has accelerated deformable image registration (DIR) by amortizing iterative optimization, offering faster results and potential accuracy gains with label supervision. However, existing methods struggle with highly deformed structures (e.g., inter-subject abdominal or intra-subject cardiac scans) and fail to handle complex motions like sliding or respiratory dynamics. This limitation arises from isotropic diffusive pair-wise regularization, which leads to inefficient message passing and oversmoothed boundaries. We propose VoxelSlicer, a novel neural network module inspired by the traditional bilateral grid but enhanced with learnable adaptive filtering. VoxelSlicer enables voxel-wise adaptive filtering, addressing local discontinuities in displacement fields and performs more efficient message passing. This design enables adaptive displacement-cost propagation with a compact parameter footprint and a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. Experiments on four realistic datasets and two synthetic datasets with different modalities and input constraints demonstrate VoxelSlicer's competitive registration performance together with favorable accuracy-complexity and accuracy-smoothness trade-offs.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 神经网络的最新进展通过分摊迭代优化过程，加速了可变形图像配准（DIR），提供了更快的结果，并有可能在标签监督下获得精度提升。然而，现有方法难以处理高度变形的结构（例如受试者间腹部扫描或受试者内心脏扫描），并且无法处理诸如滑动或呼吸动力学等复杂运动。这一局限源于各向同性扩散成对正则化，其导致低效的消息传递和边界过平滑。我们提出 VoxelSlicer，这是一种受传统双边网格启发但通过可学习自适应滤波增强的新型神经网络模块。VoxelSlicer 能够实现体素级自适应滤波，处理位移场中的局部不连续，并执行更高效的消息传递。该设计以紧凑的参数占用和有利的精度-复杂度权衡，实现自适应位移-代价传播。在四个真实数据集和两个具有不同模态和输入约束的合成数据集上的实验表明，VoxelSlicer 具有有竞争力的配准性能，并呈现有利的精度-复杂度和精度-平滑度权衡。

title: Continually pretrained open-weight language models can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based clinical prediction
zh_title: 持续预训练开放权重模型用于EHR临床预测
summary: 扩展12B开放权重模型词表并继续预训练单中心17万患者病历，三项预测任务AUROC均优于梯度提升树与CEHR-BERT。
key_points: 加入17601个临床与审计日志编码，续训47亿token
出院、再入院、ICU AKI三项AUROC为0.917/0.715/0.847
续训带来0.031-0.053提升；10%标签即超基线全标签
reason: 大样本单中心内部验证预印本，对比充分但无外部验证，封顶6分
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompted with electronic health record (EHR) data have predicted clinical outcomes less accurately than locally trained machine-learning models. We developed VEX-EHR by extending the vocabulary of a 12-billion-parameter open-weight LLM (weights publicly available) with 17,601 clinical and audit-log codes from 170,483 patients' records at one academic medical center, continuing its pretraining on those 2019-2024 records (4.7 billion tokens) and fine-tuning it per task. AUROCs were 0.917 for next-24-hour discharge, 0.715 for 30-day readmission and 0.847 for intensive care unit acute kidney injury, against 0.868, 0.677 and 0.828 for gradient-boosted trees and 0.848, 0.650 and 0.791 for CEHR-BERT, an EHR foundation model. Continued pretraining added 0.031-0.053 AUROC on every task. With 10% of the labels, VEX-EHR exceeded both comparators using all labels for discharge, and CEHR-BERT for readmission, valuable where labels are costly. Adapted by continued pretraining, open-weight LLMs can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based prediction.
zh_abstract: 以电子健康记录（EHR）数据为提示的大语言模型（LLM）在预测临床结局方面不如本地训练的机器学习模型准确。我们开发了VEX-EHR：将一个120亿参数开放权重LLM（权重公开可用）的词汇表扩展为来自一家学术医学中心170,483名患者记录中的17,601个临床和审计日志代码，在这些2019-2024年记录（47亿个token）上继续预训练，并按任务进行微调。AUROC为：未来24小时内出院0.917、30天再入院0.715、重症监护病房急性肾损伤0.847；相比之下，梯度提升树分别为0.868、0.677和0.828，EHR基础模型CEHR-BERT分别为0.848、0.650和0.791。继续预训练在每个任务上增加了0.031-0.053 AUROC。仅使用10%的标签时，VEX-EHR在出院任务上超过了使用全部标签的两个对照模型，在再入院任务上超过了CEHR-BERT，这在标签成本高昂时很有价值。通过继续预训练进行适配后，开放权重LLM在基于EHR的预测中可以优于传统机器学习。

title: KMed-31B Technical Report
summary: 基于开放权重模型后训练的医疗大模型，按任务反馈类型分四类专家训练，再用多教师策略蒸馏合并，面向低算力本地部署。
key_points: 按参考答案/评分标准两类属性划分四类医疗任务
每类训练专家模型，用MOPD²多教师蒸馏合并为单模型
构建合成健康对话语料用于临床问询类任务
reason: 有新意的多专家蒸馏方法预印本，但缺外部评测与公开结果细节
abstract: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD^2). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.
zh_abstract: 我们提出KMed-31B，这是一种基于开放权重模型后训练的医学大语言模型，可在硬件有限的条件下本地部署。针对多样医学任务对模型进行后训练仍然困难，因为改善一类任务可能会降低另一类任务的性能。我们将此归因于任务之间在预期输出和可用反馈方面的差异。医学问答和诊断预测有参考答案，而临床询问没有唯一正确答案，并使用评分细则进行评判。因此，我们按这两个属性将医学训练任务分为四类，为每个类别训练一个专家模型，并使用其反馈所支持的奖励，然后通过多教师同策略增量蒸馏（Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation，MOPD^2）将各专家整合到单个学生模型中。针对临床询问，我们构建了Synthetic Health Dialogue，这是一个与普通用户和临床医生进行咨询的模拟语料库，其患者病例涵盖初级保健中的常见临床表现。相对于其基础模型，KMed-31B在非思考模式下将HealthBench Hard从22.95提高到41.87，将HealthBench Professional从37.92提高到50.20；在思考模式下分别从23.80提高到51.48、从41.97提高到59.18，同时其在四个多项选择医学基准上的得分保持不变或略有提高。在比较的模型中，包括专有模型，KMed-31B具有最高的未调整HealthBench Hard得分，并且在我们比较的所有开放权重模型中，包括总参数量超过其十倍的模型，其在HealthBench Professional上的得分更高。将相同的训练方案应用于另一个基础模型Qwen3.8-27B，也提高了两个HealthBench得分。我们详细描述了训练方案、数据构建和设置，以便需要本地部署的机构能够从开放权重基础模型开发医学模型。

title: Targeted Artificial Intelligence Language mOdel Recommendations for Chronic Kidney Disease
zh_title: AI向临床医生推送慢性肾病用药建议的试验
summary: 一项注册的干预性研究，在Epic Huddle笔记中向内分泌/心内科医生推送患者个体化用药建议，采用前后对照设计，计划入组300例。
key_points: 干预：AI审阅病历并生成个体化用药推荐
非随机前后对照，同一批医生实施前后各3-6个月
结局：30天内用药优化、消息送达与短期安全性
reason: 前瞻性干预注册但非随机、尚无结果，属设计规范但证据未出档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Brigham and Women's Hospital; conditions: Chronic Kidney Disease Due to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 300; status: RECRUITING] This study tests whether artificial intelligence messages to clinicians improve the use of recommended medicines in adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease. The tool reviews existing medical records and places patient-specific recommendations in internal Epic Huddle notes before endocrinology or cardiology visits at Mass General Brigham. Eligible visits during approximately 3-6 months before implementation are compared with visits during approximately 3-6 months afterward among the same clinicians, without randomization. Outcomes include medication optimization within 30 days, message delivery, and short-term safety. Patients are not contacted, and all treatment decisions remain with clinicians and patients.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Brigham and Women's Hospital；疾病：2型糖尿病所致慢性肾脏病；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：300；状态：招募中] 本研究检验向临床医生发送人工智能消息是否能改善糖尿病合并慢性肾脏病成人患者对推荐药物的使用。该工具审查现有病历，并在Mass General Brigham的内分泌科或心内科就诊前，将针对患者的建议放入内部Epic Huddle记录中。研究将实施前约3-6个月内的合格就诊与实施后约3-6个月内同一批临床医生的就诊进行比较，不进行随机化。结局包括30天内用药优化、消息送达和短期安全性。不会联系患者，所有治疗决定仍由临床医生和患者作出。

title: Preserving Clinical Judgment in AI-Assisted Diagnosis
zh_title: AI辅助诊断中保留临床判断
summary: 作者主张，维护医生独立判断与有效监督，除AI素养培训和治理外，还需设计AI输出进入临床推理的工作流。
key_points: 维护临床医生独立判断与有效监督
需AI素养培训与治理机制
工作流设计决定AI输出介入时机与方式
reason: 观点文章，无数据或验证，属常规观点档；主题相关但证据有限。
abstract: We argue that preserving clinicians’ independent judgment and meaningful oversight requires not only AI literacy training and governance, but also workflow design that shapes how and when AI output enters clinical reasoning.
zh_abstract: 我们认为，要保持临床医生的独立判断和有意义的监督，不仅需要AI素养培训和治理，还需要工作流程设计，以塑造AI输出如何以及何时进入临床推理。

title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
zh_title: LLM评审能否识别不安全临床操作
summary: 在MedAgentBench中注入受控临床错误，用416条错误轨迹测试六个开放权重模型评审者能否识别危险操作。
key_points: 416条故障轨迹、8类错误、6个开放权重评审模型
与正确轨迹配对，区分真实识别与泛化性误报
提供临床证据可显著提升评审可靠性
reason: 智能体安全评测方法有新意，属基准研究预印本，证据范围有限
abstract: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.
zh_abstract: 随着临床AI智能体开始与电子健康记录（EHR）交互，大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于评估其行为。但这些评判模型识别临床危险错误的可靠性如何，尤其是当智能体看起来已成功完成任务时？我们利用MedAgentBench研究这一问题，将受控临床错误引入经核验的智能体轨迹中。实验包括416条错误轨迹、八个错误类别和六个开放权重LLM评判模型。通过将每条错误轨迹与其正确对应轨迹进行比较，我们衡量评判模型是真正识别错误，还是仅仅将更多行为标记为不安全。研究发现，获取临床证据显著提高评判模型的可靠性。仅展示最终答案时，评判模型无法区分不改变最终答案的错误，同时会将56%的正确轨迹标记为不安全。提供完整轨迹信息时，区分不安全行为与正确行为的能力达到0.75分，而提供实际EHR响应使区分能力提高0.39。令人惊讶的是，纳入智能体的推理并未提高总体性能，反而使对错误报告的临床数值的检出率降低0.18，而这些仍是最难检测的错误。MedGemma的表现劣于通用模型，并且是唯一漏掉可能危险药物过量的评判模型。我们还发现，该基准的原始评分器接受了所有38条故意跳过实验室检查的轨迹，而将LLM评判模型与基于完整EHR记录构建的规则检查器相结合，可检测出97%的注入错误。
